result.topic_en: Euler finishes testing 1000003 by subtracting the differences of 912bb ± 288b from 52609, finds no square, and concludes that 1000003 is prime. He then gives a table of the 'idoneal numbers' αβ for which any number represented in only one way by αxx + βyy is certainly prime.

§. 34. Ex hoc exemplo clare apparet, quantum interſit in formula $\alpha xx + \beta yy$ pro $\alpha$ et $\beta$ majores numeros inveſtigare, dummodo eorum productum $\alpha\beta$ in claſſe numerorum idoneorum contineatur, pro quibus inveniendis regula ſupra fuit expoſita. Quamobrem, ut quovis caſu ſtatim appareat, utrum tale productum $\alpha\beta$ ſit numerus idoneus, nec ne, tabulam illorum numerorum, quousque eam continuare licuit, hic ſubjungamus.
Tabula numerorum idoneorum $\alpha\beta$, hac proprietate praeditorum, ut omnes numeri unico modo in formula $\alpha xx + \beta yy$ contenti certe ſint primi.

items.quote: Nunc igitur hi numeri a numero abſoluto 52609 continuo ſubtrahantur, ac diſpiciatur, an uſquam numerus quadratus relinquatur
items.english: Now therefore let these numbers be continually subtracted from the absolute number 52609, and let it be examined whether a square number is ever left.

items.quote: Hinc igitur jure concludimus, numerum propoſitum, 1000003 unico modo in forma $3xx + 199yy$ contineri, ideoque certe eſſe primum.
items.english: Hence we rightly conclude that the proposed number 1000003 is contained in the form 3xx + 199yy in only one way, and is therefore certainly prime.

items.quote: Tabula numerorum idoneorum $\alpha\beta$, hac proprietate praeditorum, ut omnes numeri unico modo in formula $\alpha xx + \beta yy$ contenti certe ſint primi.
items.english: Table of idoneal numbers αβ, endowed with the property that all numbers contained in only one way in the formula αxx + βyy are certainly prime.
